subject: camera rotation convention diverges from the existing production DirectReferenceSource affine
failure_mode: For nonzero camera rotation, CameraController maps the same world point to a different view point than the render plan and converts pointer coordinates back to the wrong world point.
impact: Demo hit/select can select a different object than the one visibly under the pointer whenever the camera is rotated.
frozen_requirement: G3-08-V1 camera transform plus G3-08-V2 G2-authoritative hit delegation at the camera-derived world point
root_cause: The forward and inverse sine signs in the new demo controller were transposed relative to runtime/render/src/direct_reference_source.cpp.
